android.desc:
Proven reliability with over 35 million downloads worldwide. Private. Offline. Professional.

MapFactor Navigator is a professional GPS navigation app for those who value autonomy and privacy. With high-quality offline maps from OpenStreetMaps (updated monthly for FREE), you can navigate over 200 countries without an internet connection, without third-party tracking, and without external ads. Enjoy precise voice guidance, speed limit alerts, and seamless Android Auto integration.

PRIVACY AND AD-FREE EXPERIENCE
While others profit from your data, MapFactor keeps you safe:
• No Third-Party Ads: A clean, distraction-free interface. We don't sell your screen space.
• Total Privacy: We do not track your movements or sell your location history.
• 100% Offline Capability: Maps are stored locally. Navigate anywhere without data roaming.
• No Account Required: Start navigating immediately without forced registrations.

KEY FEATURES
• Intuitive Voice Navigation with a clear maneuver overview and distance to the next turn shown on screen.
• Door-to-door route planning with 2D/3D visual modes.
• Detailed Offline Maps with postcodes (full GB) installed on your device or SD card.
• Specialized Routing: Modes for car, truck, bus, motorhome (camper), bicycle, or motorcycle. 
• Favorite Routes and Places for quick access.
• Safety First: Speed limit warnings, camera alerts, and lane assistant.
• Android Auto Connectivity for a seamless dashboard experience.
• Route Avoidance: Easily block specific roads or areas from your journey.

NAVIGATOR TRUCK: FOR LARGE VEHICLES
Professional navigation for trucks, buses, and motorhomes (available with TomTom Truck maps):
• Specialized Routing: Avoids restrictions like low bridges, weight limits, and narrow lanes.
• Precision Truck Routing (v8.1+): Enhanced professional-grade accuracy for fleet and heavy vehicle safety.

NEW AND UNIQUE FEATURES
• MapStick Support: Import professional TomTom maps via USB flash disk without any data connection.
• Nearby POIs Along Route: Real-time display of selected points (gas, parking, EV chargers) directly on the navigation screen.

GLOBAL COVERAGE (200+ Countries) 
Free monthly map updates for all major regions:
• EUROPE: UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Poland, Austria, Netherlands, Czech Rep., Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, Serbia, Switzerland, Romania and more.
• AMERICA: USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, etc.
• ASIA: India, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia,

quotes.text:
Check out MapFactor Navigator. Has a good single-line global offline search feature, usually two search terms (such as street/POI name and city or postal code) suffice.
Also very good turn by turn voice navigation, an intuitive touch UI and other things one likes to see in a GPS app.
Completely free on Android with OSM offline maps (which they distribute in a heavily compressed but rather complete format).
Not affiliated but wouldn't drive out of town without it. You can also buy and use commercial TomTom maps within the same app if preferred.
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mapfactor.navigator
There is also an iOS version.

quotes.text:
For those looking for a good Android app that uses OSM. I use Mapfactor Navigator and think it is great (I've used it in Italy, Austria, Slovenia, Crozia). It let's you use it with OSM data or Tom Tom, you can use Google for address search and use it offline if you need.

I'm not affiliated, just a happy user

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mapfactor.navigator
